content.value_statement: Teams need consistent UI patterns without rebuilding common animations. This skill provides ShadCN and Framer Motion examples for cards, lists, dialogs, transitions, and loading states.
actual_capabilities: Shows pnpm commands to initialize ShadCN UI and add common components.
Provides React examples for ShadCN Button, Card, and Dialog components.
Demonstrates Framer Motion fade, hover, tap, and page transition patterns.
Shows animated list rendering with variants, staggered children, and AnimatePresence.
Includes a pulsing loading skeleton pattern.
limitations: Does not include a full project scaffold or runnable demo.
Assumes React, TypeScript, ShadCN UI, and Framer Motion fit the project.
Does not cover accessibility testing for animated components.
Uses concise examples and does not explain every dependency setting.

use_cases.title: Add Motion to UI Components
use_cases.description: Enhance existing ShadCN cards, buttons, and dialogs with practical Framer Motion patterns.

use_cases.title: Translate Interaction Specs
use_cases.description: Convert simple motion requirements into React component patterns for lists, dialogs, and page transitions.

use_cases.title: Prototype Animated Screens
use_cases.description: Create credible animated interface states quickly during early product development.

prompt_templates.title: Start with ShadCN
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to initialize ShadCN UI and add Button, Card, and Dialog components for my React app.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a ShadCN Card with a gentle fade-in and hover effect for a profile summary.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Animated List
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an animated list pattern with Framer Motion variants, staggered items, and stable keys for these items: [describe items].

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Dialog Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this modal into a ShadCN Dialog with AnimatePresence enter and exit animations while preserving accessibility behavior: [paste component].

output_examples.input: Add animation to a profile card.
output: Recommends a ShadCN Card structure with header, content, and footer sections.
Adds a Framer Motion wrapper for fade-in, hover lift, and tap feedback.
Keeps animation timing short to avoid slowing repeated UI use.

output_examples.input: Create an animated list for notifications.
output: Defines a parent animation plan with staggered child timing.
Uses AnimatePresence for entering and exiting notification rows.
Explains how stable item identifiers prevent animation glitches.
Suggests a muted skeleton element with a pulsing opacity animation.
Keeps the placeholder shape close to the final content size.
Notes that repeated animations should remain subtle.

best_practices: Keep motion durations short for interface actions that users repeat often.
Use stable keys for animated lists so items enter and exit predictably.
Preserve ShadCN accessibility behavior when wrapping components with motion elements.
anti_patterns: Do not animate every component on a dense operational screen.
Do not replace accessible ShadCN primitives with custom motion-only elements.
Do not use large layout shifts for routine hover or tap feedback.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build animated React interfaces using ShadCN UI components and Framer Motion patterns.

faq.question: Does it install ShadCN UI automatically?
faq.answer: No. It shows setup commands and examples, but execution depends on the user or agent workflow.

faq.question: Can I use it with Next.js?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples fit client-side React components that are common in Next.js applications.

faq.question: Does it include complete design system guidance?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on component usage and motion examples, not full design system governance.

faq.question: Can it help with dialogs and page transitions?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes patterns for animated dialogs and simple page transition wrappers.

faq.question: Is this useful in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill provides reusable guidance for AI coding workflows in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
